description: This PHP source file defines the class `Chart_pipeline_by_lead_source`, which generates a pie chart visualization of opportunities grouped by lead source within the SuiteCRM/SugarCRM environment. It includes methods for rendering the chart, generating XML data for the chart, and constructing database queries to retrieve opportunity data filtered by lead source and user preferences. The class manages session persistence, caches XML data, and integrates with SuiteCRM's UI components.

classes.name: Chart_pipeline_by_lead_source
classes.description: Defines methods for rendering a lead source pipeline chart, generating XML chart data, and building the corresponding database query. Used within SuiteCRM for visual reporting of opportunity data categorized by lead source.

methods.name: draw
methods.description: Renders the chart interface, including filter controls, caching, and invoking XML generation for the chart image.

methods.name: gen_xml
methods.description: Generates the XML data for a pie chart visualization of opportunities grouped by lead source, with caching support and database querying.

methods.name: constructQuery
methods.description: Builds and returns the SQL query string to retrieve opportunity data filtered by lead source and user preferences.

methods.name: constructGroupBy
methods.description: Returns the grouping criteria for the database query, here grouping by 'lead_source'.
